card.name: Start of gamma and gado- names
card.fires_on: The word gamma in gamma-glutamyl transferase after a list of liver enzymes, and the start of gadolinium agent names like gadopentetate. Also a space before a number such as 40 kg or 5 mL.

card.writes: It seems to push toward rare name-like word pieces and away from diagnosis-related words.
card.plain: It fires at the start of a long lab-test or contrast-agent name, such as gamma-glutamyl transferase or gadopentetate.
